title: Aeronautics and Space Report of the President: Fiscal Years 2021 and 2022
summary: NASA published a combined report for FY 2021 and FY 2022 federal aerospace activities. The combined reporting period is a series break and cannot be treated as two independent annual observations.
key_findings: NASA published a combined report for FY 2021 and FY 2022 federal aerospace activities.
Method: Annual federal-department and agency reporting with historical launch and budget appendices.
Denominator: Federal aerospace activities and appendix measures included in the stated fiscal-year report.
Attribution: Federal department and agency reporting coordinated by NASA.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the aeronautics and space report of the president series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for carrier, operator, and mission service outcomes.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: The combined reporting period is a series break and cannot be treated as two independent annual observations.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Federal aerospace activities and appendix measures included in the stated fiscal-year report.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
